answer_extraction.binary_extraction: binary answer extraction; closed-grammar semantic guard after valid Qwen A/B/Z output; raw generation preserved

external_submission.output_format: UTF-8 JSON with two-space indentation and a final newline; sample files are arrays of objects; metrics and manifest are objects
external_submission.answer_cache: optional extracted_answers.json array from a completed evaluation; IDs must match the submitted predictions; validated before reuse
external_submission.file_format: UTF-8 JSONL (optional BOM); one object per unique nonblank string sample_id; every prediction ID must have a matching annotation; unused annotations are excluded from evaluation
external_submission.evaluation_samples: submitted predictions only, processed in annotation order; metrics and run manifest record annotation, evaluated and unused annotation counts
external_submission.gt_objects: all_relevant_gt_objects: [{class: target_class, bbox: [x1,y1,x2,y2]}]; original image pixels
external_submission.extra_prediction_fields: ignored; only sample_id, raw_answer and evidence_boxes are consumed; --model supplies the result label
external_submission.raw_prediction_regions: only evidence_boxes; raw_answer coordinates never supply scoring boxes
external_submission.coordinate_contract: original-image pixels, origin at upper left, x rightward, y downward; no unit option or coordinate conversion
external_submission.structured_boxes_format: evidence_boxes: [[xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], ...]; no boxes: []; four finite numbers, positive area, entirely within the original image; values preserved without clipping or reordering
external_submission.answer_view: unambiguous JSON language fields plus comments and surrounding prose; other responses preserved whole for the frozen extractor; no coordinate grammar required
external_submission.json_response_comments: line/block comments in response JSON retained in source order with semantic fields; explanations and corrections preserved
external_submission.generation_status: external prediction status fields are ignored; AESP answer-extraction results and caches still reject processing failures

limits: Scoring geometry comes only from submitted original-image pixel xyxy evidence_boxes.
Frozen LLM extraction can make semantic errors.
Source integrity does not authenticate externally supplied predictions or caches.
